name: Sign Rank of Singletons
proof: The incidence sign matrix of the singleton class is the $n\times n$ signed identity matrix: it has positive diagonal and negative off-diagonal entries.  Its sign rank is 3 for $n\geq4$ (Claim 1 in the cited paper).  For $n=3$, three vectors at angles $0,120,240$ degrees give a rank-two realization; for $n\leq2$, the displayed sign matrix has rank one.
